name: aspire-orchestration-environment
description: A local .NET Aspire AppHost runtime with process permission for non-interactive lifecycle operations.

tools.aspire_start: Starts the known valid local AppHost when process_permission is granted; adds app_running.
tools.aspire_wait: Waits for the AppHost resource after the app is running; adds resource_ready.
tools.aspire_describe: Records resource status after the resource is ready while the AppHost is running; adds status_recorded.
tools.aspire_stop: Stops the running AppHost; removes app_running and resource_ready.
tools.aspire_doctor: Records diagnostics for the Aspire environment; adds diagnostics_recorded.

lacks: Cloud credentials are irrelevant to this local lifecycle runtime.
Source edits and resource restarts are outside this task.
